response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a grand, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty? But we are in the 14th century.

KING
(nodding)
Exactly! We must push the boundaries of what is possible. We must... we must... (he gestures grandly)...we must vaporwave our aesthetic.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king, surrounded by his courtiers and advisors, begins to outline his vision. He speaks of a new era of sleek, futuristic design, of neon-lit castles and cyberpunk-inspired armor.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We will no longer be bound by the shackles of tradition. We will be the pioneers of a new era. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of retro-futurism.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The king's vision begins to take shape. The kingdom's architecture is transformed, with sleek, curved lines and neon lights illuminating the streets. The knights, once clad in armor, now wear futuristic jumpsuits and sport cybernetic enhancements.

KING
(to his people)
Behold, my subjects! A new era has dawned upon us. An era of... of... (he gestures grandly)...of vaporwave majesty!

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king, surrounded by his advisors, reviews the kingdom's new aesthetic. He nods in approval as they discuss the finer points of vaporwave design.

KING
(to Zorvath)
I am pleased, my friend. Our empire is now the envy of all the land.

ZORVATH
(smiling)
Indeed, Your Majesty. You have truly... you have truly... (he searches for the right words)...you have vaporwaved our aesthetic.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom's new aesthetic is on full display. The people, once clad in traditional garb, now wear futuristic attire and sport cybernetic enhancements. The king, resplendent in his vaporwave-inspired armor, rides through the streets on a sleek, neon-lit steed.

KING
(to his people)
Long live our vaporwave empire! Long live... long live... (he searches for the right words)...long live the future!

FADE TO BLACK.
